module.purpose: Verifies middleware method restrictions for web application and API routes.
module.summary: This test module exercises the POST-method guard used by web middleware. It builds requests against the configured application URL and verifies that API routes permit POST, non-API application routes reject POST with a 405 response and GET Allow header, and GET remains permitted across both route categories.
module.businessContext: The web application must prevent unsupported POST requests while preserving API and normal page access. Incorrect behavior could block valid API operations or expose unsupported application methods.
functions: createRequest (~L9-15): Constructs a NextRequest with a configured URL, path, and method.
Middleware - POST requests restriction (~L8-43): Groups middleware method restriction behavior tests.
should allow POST requests to /api routes (~L17-21): Verifies POST requests are permitted on API routes.
should block POST requests to not-allowed app routes (~L23-30): Verifies unsupported application POST requests return method errors.
should allow GET requests to app routes (~L32-36): Verifies GET requests are permitted on application routes.
should allow GET requests to /api routes (~L38-42): Verifies GET requests are permitted on API routes.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A POST request targets an /api route.
moduleContractTests.rationale: API routes must permit POST requests without returning a response.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A POST request targets a non-API application route.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Non-API application routes must reject POST and advertise GET as the allowed method.

moduleContractTests.rationale: Application routes must continue allowing GET requests.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A GET request targets an /api route.
moduleContractTests.rationale: API routes must permit GET requests without returning a response.
